title: The website's engine download is a fifth smaller
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The browser build of the engine no longer ships a table of Rust function names that only profilers and crash traces use. It drops from 356 KB to 285 KB (109 KB compressed, down from 117 KB). The engine code is untouched: every match gives the same hashes as before, and the native-vs-browser parity check passes. The one trade-off is that a crash trace shows numbered functions instead of names; developers can rebuild with names to read one.
